title: Consciousness is the intrinsic nature of physical properties

statements.text: The categorical nature of matter that physics leaves undescribed is consciousness. Physics describes mass, spin and charge from the outside, and in themselves these properties are forms of consciousness, not experiential properties beside physical ones.

sources.quote: What then is the concrete categorical nature of matter? Panpsychism offers us an answer: consciousness.
The positive proposal of Russellian panpsychism is to put consciousness in this hole: physical properties are, in their essential nature, forms of consciousness.
